# Empowering data teams since 2011

Matillion is the intelligent data integration platform that empowers data teams to build and manage pipelines faster for AI and analytics - at scale.

![HR about 1](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/HR-about-1.jpg)

![HR about 2](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/HR-about-2.jpg)

![HR about 3](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/HR-about-3.jpg)

### Matillion exists because we believe in a few fundamental truths:

- Every business needs to compete using data – data-delivery is high-impact business.
- Data engineering is often boring, gritty and repetitive.
- There aren’t enough data engineers to meet demand; data engineers need to be highly skilled and demand for their skills is ever-growing.

Matillion exists to remove this friction, 100x productivity and open up data integration to the entire business, with AI and for AI, enabling data teams to spend their time doing business-impacting work, not managing technology.

**2011**

#### June

The Data Productivity Cloud officially launches, marking a new chapter in Matillion’s leadership in the data integration space.

#### May

Matillion introduces Change Data Capture (CDC) and data replication capabilities.

#### September

Matillion closes Series E funding round at a $1.5 billion valuation, making it a tech unicorn.

#### May

Matillion launches for Microsoft Azure Synapse.

#### December

Matillion Data Loader launches.

#### November

Matillion ETL for Snowflake launches.

#### June

Matillion ETL for Google BigQuery launches.

#### October

A polished-up version of Emerald debuts worldwide on the AWS Marketplace as Matillion ETL for Amazon Redshift.

#### January

Matillion launches Emerald, its internal tool purpose-built to bring data into the cloud data warehouse and transform it there.

#### February

Matillion decides to build their own tool: Project Emerald begins.

After building dozens of cloud data warehouses, building and running thousands of ETL jobs in Amazon Redshift, and getting millions of rows of data ready for analytics, Matillion realizes two things. First, complex data transformation needs the speed, scale, and economics of the cloud. Second, no existing ETL tool really does this well.

#### August

After an all-night hackathon in Knutsford, Matillion migrates its BI solution to Amazon Redshift. They become experts in handling data and BI on the new platform.

#### December

Amazon introduces Amazon Redshift.

Matthew Scullion and Ed Thompson quit their jobs to revolutionize business intelligence in the cloud. In a rural area near Manchester, UK, Ed codes Matillion's first product while Matthew establishes the company's guiding principles. Matillion provides cloud-based business intelligence analytics, building multiple data warehouses in AWS.

![About Today Mod4](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/images/About_Today_Mod4.svg)

#### Matillion today

Today, Matillion is a global company, born in Manchester. We’re a distributed team working between dual headquarters in Denver and Manchester. Thousands of enterprises including [Cisco](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories/cisco), [DocuSign](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories/docusign), [St. James Place](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories/st-jamess-place), [Slack](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories/slack), and [TUI](https://www.matillion.com/success-stories/tui-hotels-and-resorts) trust Matillion to move, transform and automate their data.

Matillioners are spread around the globe but we still like to meet up at our Manchester headquarters once a year for company planning and training, good conversation, darts, and to enjoy the British weather.

### We never stop working for data teams, and it shows

#### CRN 2023 Big Data 100

[CRN’s Big Data 100](https://www.crn.com/news/software/the-coolest-data-management-and-integration-software-companies-of-the-2023-big-data-100/19) is an annual list of leading vendors in the big data space with innovative, forward-thinking products and services that solution providers can offer their customers for managing, utilizing and analyzing big data.

![Data breakthrough Award](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/logos/data_breakthrough_Award.svg)

#### 2023 Data Breakthrough Award

[The Data Breakthrough Awards](https://databreakthroughawards.com/2023-winners/) evaluate, analyze and recognize the standout solutions and companies in the data technology market from all across the globe.

![FT1000 2023](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/logos/FT1000_2023_2023-06-02-200103_fxwu.svg)

#### 2023 FT1000

Every year, the Financial Times recognises European companies from various sectors that have achieved significant sales growth. The [FT1000 award](https://www.ft.com/ft1000-2023) is presented in collaboration with renowned market research company Statista, which carries out the analysis, evaluates the sales figures and compiles the data.

![Impact 50 i BD](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/logos/Impact-50-iBD.svg)

#### InsideBIGDATA Impact 50

The companies included in [this list](https://insidebigdata.com/2023/01/17/the-insidebigdata-impact-50-list-for-q1-2023/) come from our massive data set of vendors and associated industry metrics, using machine learning to analyze the industry to determine an optimized ranking for the list.

### Corporate profile

Matillion is data transformation for cloud data warehouses. Our software empowers customers to extract data from a wide number of data sources, load data into their chosen cloud data warehouses, and then transform that data from its siloed source state into useful, analytics-ready data that helps businesses unlock the hidden value in their business.

Our leading investors:

![](https://www.matillion.com/cache/imager/www_matillion_com/uploads/logos/Lightspeed-2_2023-05-16-170603_vnbf_b4589a2bd8e72d5ff15e61817fd15d0a.png)

#### Lightspeed Venture Partners

Lightspeed Venture Partners is a multi-stage venture capital firm focused on accelerating disruptive innovations and trends in the Enterprise, Consumer, and Health sectors. The firm was a leading investor in the Series D round.

![](https://www.matillion.com/cache/imager/www_matillion_com/uploads/logos/battery-ventures-2_b4589a2bd8e72d5ff15e61817fd15d0a.png)

#### Battery

Battery Ventures is a global, technology-focused investment firm founded in 1983. It pursues the most prominent companies and ideas from six offices around the world. Battery was a leading investor in the Series C funding round.

![](https://www.matillion.com/cache/imager/www_matillion_com/uploads/logos/Sapphire-Ventures-Logo_2023-05-16-170618_ylfl_b4589a2bd8e72d5ff15e61817fd15d0a.png)

#### Sapphire Ventures

Sapphire Ventures is a venture capital firm based out of Palo Alto, California, and focused on helping innovative technology companies become global category-defining leaders. The firm was a leading investor in the Series B funding round.

![](https://www.matillion.com/cache/imager/www_matillion_com/uploads/logos/Scale_b4589a2bd8e72d5ff15e61817fd15d0a.jpeg)

#### Scale Venture Partners

Scale Venture Partners invests in software companies that are transforming the future of work. Based out of Foster City, California, Scale invests in the intelligent connected world. The firm was a leading investor in the Series B funding round.

![](https://www.matillion.com/cache/imager/www_matillion_com/uploads/logos/yfm-equity-partners-3_b4589a2bd8e72d5ff15e61817fd15d0a.png)

#### YFM Equity Partners

YFM Equity Partners is a London-based, independent private equity business owned by its senior management and investment team. The company was a leading investor in the Series A funding round.

![](https://www.matillion.com/cache/imager/www_matillion_com/uploads/logos/General-Atlantic-2_b4589a2bd8e72d5ff15e61817fd15d0a.jpeg)

#### General Atlantic

General Atlantic is a leading global growth equity firm with more than four decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 400 growth companies throughout its history.
